# Fires Fires are perhaps the most dangerous atmospheric emergencies that can occur on the station.
They often create high-pressure, high-temperature gases that can spread rapidly through the station if firelocks or doors are carelessly opened, even for a moment.
People caught in a fire can quickly lose consciousness, die, and even be burned to ash, after which they cannot be revived.
## Fighting Fires The key elements of a fire are fuel and oxygen. Removing either one will extinguish the fire. For example, fires without an oxygen supply will gradually suffocate, and fires without fuel will also go out.
Exposing a fire to space will extinguish it because all the gas will simply escape outside. You can then [textlink="repair" link="ExpandingRepairingStation"] the [textlink="breach" link="Spacing"] and repressurize the area.
## Tips - [bold]Know the warning signs of a fire.[/bold] If an area is filled with highly flammable gases, it is only a matter of time before a careless passenger ignites them. Try to isolate the area and remove the gases as quickly as possible. - [bold]Prevent gases from spreading with a holofan projector.[/bold] Letting gas pass through a firelock, even for a moment, can make other rooms dangerous and increase the number of areas you will need to repair.
